cases.name: roster-20
cases.query: SELECT * FROM public.get_league_projection_rows((SELECT id FROM public.leagues ORDER BY id LIMIT 1),2026,'2025-10-28','today',ARRAY(SELECT player_id FROM public.roster_players ORDER BY id LIMIT 20),1000,0) ORDER BY player_id
